question.text: PMs shall NOT indulge in speculative transactions i.e. transactions:

answer.text: Settled otherwise than by actual delivery (except derivatives)

explanation.text: The Logic: Speculative = non-delivery-based transactions (except allowed derivatives). The Trap: Delivery-based trades are compliant. Cross-Exam Context: Same rule in III-A. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Intraday cash-segment trades are discouraged for PMS portfolios.
